steps.question: Is this subagent's task routine work that a smaller model handles well, such as searching, reading and summarising code or docs, or a mechanical edit, rather than hard design, debugging or review?

then.text: Chauffeur: the user asks that subagents doing routine work run on a cheaper model from your own provider. Pass model "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5" when you run on Claude Opus, or "openai/gpt-6-luna" when you run on GPT-6.1 Sol, on your next subagent calls.
